Name: Stardew Modded and Vanilla NPC Schedule Fixes
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center][size=6][b][u]Schedule Collision Fixes[/u][/b][/size]
[i]Stop modded NPCs from standing on top of each other.[/i][/center]

[size=4][b]One download for everyone[/b][/size]
This mod used to come in two versions, one for [b]Forest Compatibility Patch[/b] users and one without. Version 1.2.0 merges them. The forest fixes now switch on by themselves when Forest Compatibility Patch is installed.
[color=#e06666][b]If you had the "Forest Compatibility" version, delete it before installing this one.[/b][/color]

[line]

[size=5][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54968/54968-1793759053-709505727.png[/img][/b][/size]
This pack nudges NPCs a tile or two apart so they stop piling on top of each other, both in their daily routines and at festivals. There's nothing to set up. Each fix only switches on when every mod it involves is installed. If you don't have a mod, its fixes do nothing.

When two NPCs from different mods are booked onto the same tile at the same time, one of them steps over to a nearby spot. Only that one step of their day changes. The rest of their schedule, their animations and their dialogue stay exactly as their author wrote them.
[list]
[*]New spots are open floor the NPC can actually walk to, with nobody else there at that time.[/*]
[*]NPCs who were sitting get a seat, and NPCs at the arcade, gym or a shop shelf end up beside the same kind of prop.[/*]
[*]When a modded NPC shares a tile with a base-game villager or an SVE NPC, the villager steps aside wherever there's a good spot. That way other mods' schedules are changed as little as possible.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54968/54968-1793759016-1133542139.png[/img][/b][/size]
The same goes for festival setups and main events, in both odd-year and even-year layouts:
[list]
[*]Egg Festival, Flower Dance, Luau, Dance of the Moonlight Jellies, Stardew Valley Fair, Spirit's Eve, Festival of Ice, Feast of the Winter Star[/*]
[*]Smaller schedule-based events: Desert Festival, Night Market, Trout Derby, SquidFest, SVE's Joja Day and Community Day, and Law and Order's Murder Mystery Festival[/*]
[*]NPCs are also kept off festival props and off the spots where you're warped in for the main event. Villagers who walk around or take part in a festival's cutscene stay put.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54968/54968-1793759107-403854389.png[/img][/b][/size]
Some NPC mods were made for the vanilla map. When SVE or another mod reshapes the beach or a pond, those NPCs can end up standing in the water. They're moved to the nearest dry spot. NPCs who are meant to be by the water, whether swimming, fishing or sitting on the dock, are left alone.

[size=4][b]Plays nicely with Forest Compatibility Patch[/b][/size]
Every spot was checked against [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54530]Forest Compatibility Patch[/url]: Valko's moved tent, the Ornithologist's Guild, the wall behind Fernando's house and the new lampposts. There's also one extra fix for it, so Xalathar waits outside Fernando's house instead of inside its wall.

[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.4 or newer[/*]
[/list]Every NPC mod is optional. The pack only touches the ones you actually have.
[line]

[b]Schedule Viewer[/b] works out of the box. It shows the fixed spots, the area names it displays stay the same, and nobody is moved into a room that needs hearts to enter.

[line]

[size=5][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Mod updates:[/b] if an NPC mod rewrites one of its schedule lines, the matching fix just stops applying. Nothing breaks, but that overlap may come back until this pack catches up. Reports are always welcome![/*]
[*][b]Not covered:[/b] NPCs moving around in cutscenes, and the Desert Festival booth vendors and Night Market merchants, since the game places those itself each day.[/*]
[/list]The download includes [font=Courier New]CHANGES.md[/font], which lists every moved spot: who, from where, to where, and why.

[line]

[size=5][b]Permissions & credits[/b][/size]
No art, maps or writing from other mods are included. Each fix is a small text edit that swaps one tile position in another mod's schedule or festival entry for a nearby one, or moves a villager's festival marker one tile on SVE's festival map.

A big thank-you to every NPC author whose characters are in here. The valley is a lot more crowded, and a lot more fun, because of you.
